title: Every strict nonzero Maxwell mode is nonresonant with one massive Klein--Gordon branch

phase_geometry.declared_phase: For p in Z^3 minus {0}, k in Z^3, M_q^2=m^2+mu q^2>0, set omega_q(k)=sqrt(M_q^2+|k|^2) and Phi_q(k,p)=|p|+omega_q(k)-omega_q(k+p)
phase_geometry.positive_numerator: Writing k_parallel=k dot p/|p| and k_perp=k-k_parallel p/|p|, |p| omega_q(k)-p dot k=|p|(M_q^2+|k_perp|^2)/(omega_q(k)+k_parallel)>0
phase_geometry.nonresonance: Phi_q(k,p)>0 for every p!=0; K1435's p=0 harmonic resonance is absent in the strict zero-harmonic sector
phase_geometry.parallel_asymptotic: Along k=K p/|p| with K tending to infinity, Phi_q(k,p) is asymptotic to M_q^2 |p|/(2K^2)
phase_geometry.scope: This classifies one massive three-wave phase. Other sign combinations, full gauge-current tensors, spacetime estimates, and the nonlinear PDE remain separate
